shortDescription.text: Claude Code's safety check decides, not a rule of yours

fullDescription.text: In auto mode, a high-stakes action with no rule of yours is judged by Claude Code's own classifier.

help.text: It may well stop it, but you can't see or set its rules, so the harness doesn't say what should happen. Make the call yourself: a permission rule that allows, asks or refuses.
help.markdown:
In auto mode, a high-stakes action with no rule of yours is judged by Claude Code's own classifier.

**Why it matters:** It may well stop it, but you can't see or set its rules, so the harness doesn't say what should happen.

**What to do:** Make the call yourself: a permission rule that allows, asks or refuses.

shortDescription.text: It stops when it says it's done

fullDescription.text: Nothing checks the work before it ends: the agent decides it's finished.

help.text: Loop on evidence, not confidence. Saying it's done is never enough. Add a completion check: a Stop hook that runs the check commands and sends failures back.
help.markdown:
Nothing checks the work before it ends: the agent decides it's finished.

**Why it matters:** Loop on evidence, not confidence. Saying it's done is never enough.

**What to do:** Add a completion check: a Stop hook that runs the check commands and sends failures back.

shortDescription.text: A skill the model may misuse

fullDescription.text: A skill has a problem in its own text: no description, no steps, a name that doesn't match its folder, or rules that contradict.

help.text: The model picks skills by their description and follows their steps; a vague or broken one fires wrongly or does the wrong thing. Fix the skill's text as the message says.
help.markdown:
A skill has a problem in its own text: no description, no steps, a name that doesn't match its folder, or rules that contradict.

**Why it matters:** The model picks skills by their description and follows their steps; a vague or broken one fires wrongly or does the wrong thing.

**What to do:** Fix the skill's text as the message says.
